_comment: The 19 exclusive sets, in the owner's order (docs/PETS-AND-SETS.md). Keys and prefixes are DATA: never rename. Power = 1.05^(index-1) from zone 1's level (owner, 2026-10-10). counts = the owner's table: C U R E L M D X.

sets.name: Pebblebound
sets.theme: Basic minerals, earthy palette, starter collection. Rock textures and ore formations, no extravagant effects; the top pack reveals an impressive underground geode, but it stays a basic collection.

sets.name: Sugar Rush
sets.theme: Candy, pastels, playful collecting. Bright and friendly, glossy sweets and candy patterns. The appeal is charm, not legendary prestige.

sets.name: Mosswood
sets.theme: Forests, moss, natural curiosities. Muted greens, wood grain, moss and tiny natural discoveries. No giant magical tree or blinding green energy.

sets.name: Lost & Found
sets.theme: Everyday treasures, maps, curiosities. An accessible treasure-hunting theme; rarer discoveries without turning everything into a royal vault.

sets.name: Starfront
sets.theme: Space exploration, planets, orbital structures. Grounded sci-fi: space landscapes and orbital machinery, not universe-ending cosmic events.

sets.name: Arcade Legends
sets.theme: Retro games, pixel art, neon. A cohesive, nostalgic arcade collection.

sets.name: Crystal Hollow
sets.theme: Minerals, geodes, crystal formations. Geology and mineral collecting, not generic magic: crystals with different silhouettes, structures and natural inclusions.

sets.name: Shogun's Oath
sets.theme: Japanese motifs, weapons, honour. Lacquer, gold-leaf waves, traditional patterns, weapon displays.

sets.name: Royal Reserve
sets.theme: Luxury packaging, precious materials, prestige. Engraved gold, black velvet, sophisticated symmetry.

sets.name: Crimson Eclipse
sets.theme: Gothic relics, blood-red celestial motifs. A highly cohesive dark-red collection (kid-friendly gothic, never gory).

sets.name: Holo Havoc
sets.theme: Holographic materials, chrome, optical effects. Refraction, reflective chrome and holographic foil, not generic fantasy.

sets.name: Rainbow Road
sets.theme: Prismatic crystals, rainbow refraction, colourful worlds. From simple pastel hues to extraordinary prismatic structures. Natural rainbow crystal formations, NOT chrome foil (that is Holo Havoc).

sets.name: Infernal Reign
sets.theme: Obsidian, molten rock, infernal architecture. Black volcanic stone, iron, lava channels; avoids the generic demon portrait (kid-friendly).

sets.name: Atlantis Rising
sets.theme: Underwater ruins, pearls, lost civilizations. Turquoise and gold, underwater architecture, coral formations.

sets.name: Divine Relics
sets.theme: Sacred artifacts, ancient mechanisms, mythic craftsmanship: objects that appear to have shaped the world.

sets.name: Dragonfall
sets.theme: Dragon mythology, ancient hoards, volcanic ruins. Fossilized skulls, dragon scales, enormous hoards, ancient structures.

sets.name: Eternal Roots
sets.theme: Cosmic nature, ancient life, world-scale roots (was Worldtree): an enormous root system connecting worlds, buried springs, root caverns.

sets.name: Mythic Menagerie
sets.theme: Legendary species, ancient fossils, creature ecosystems. The creature-collecting flagship: habitats, nests, eggs; the creatures are the stars.

sets.name: Chaos Theory
sets.theme: Reality distortion, fractured geometry, cosmic anomalies. Broken geometry, distorted materials, impossible perspective, fractured reality.
